_method: hand-written against the cited source lines; status codes + bodies copied verbatim, then re-read. No live Django.

body.message: Start date cannot exceed target date

errors.when: any update's merged (new or current) start > target (note 'message' key, not 'error')

bulk_dates.note: issues missing from DB are silently SKIPPED (:1155-1156); issues appended TWICE when both dates set (bulk_update applies both fields anyway); bulk_update -> NO signals (see FX-ISS-21). Date strings parsed '%Y-%m-%d' — other formats raise ValueError -> 500.
bulk_dates.per_date_enqueue: issue_activity type=issue.activity.updated per SET date (requested_data={start_date: new} / current_instance={start_date: str(current)}; NO notification/origin keys!)

body.error: You are not allowed to view this issue

identifier.guards: NO @allow_permission decorator — manual membership check inside (any active ProjectMember; guests gated by guest_view_all_features unless owner)

responses.lite: 200 + 15-key hand-built dict (serialize_lite_issue :1223-1240; datetimes RAW, not isoformat — DRF renders them in Response!)

identifier.note: ?lite=1/true/yes (case-insensitive) selects lite. manual Project identifier__iexact lookup (no _rewrite_project_kwarg — route has no project_id kwarg).

sub_issues.note: POST links via bulk_update(parent) -> NO signals (see FX-ISS-21); per-sub-issue issue_activity enqueues (requested_data={parent: parent_id}, current_instance={parent: sub_id} — note current holds the SUB id, likely a bug: should be old parent)

user_properties.patch: get-or-create then partial ProjectUserPropertySerializer save -> 200 full row
